name: Ameverse: Dimensional Peril
source:
Amelia's beloved pocket watch malfunctions, sending her on a race against time to get back home before it fully breaks down. 

Help Ame get back home by traversing bizarre and harsh dimensions to fix her pocket watch before she is stuck forever.

[From [url=https://spinecricket.itch.io/ameverse-peril]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿米莉亚心爱的怀表出现故障，她必须与时间赛跑，才能在怀表完全损坏之前回到家。

帮助艾梅回家，穿越奇异而严酷的维度，在她被永远困住之前修好她的怀表。

[来自[url=https://spinecricket.itch.io/ameverse-peril]itch.io[/url]]
